# Port report: the chat list slice

Branch `port/chatlist` (from `chore/bump-frameact-engine`), tt baseline `090e38f`. The second UI slice of telegram-dd: the
main shell (`Main`), the left column (`LeftColumn` -> `LeftMain` -> `ChatFolders` / `ChatList` / `Chat`, the main menu, the
search field) and what they reach. The middle and right columns are placeholders in this slice.

(The report is filled in as the slice progresses; the inventory below is generated.)
